Question 9
?

Find the first two non-zero terms of the Maclaurin expansion of ex2−e−x2.

a
ex2−e−x2=2x2+x63+⋯
b
ex2−e−x2=2x2+x46+⋯
c
ex2−e−x2=x22−x624+⋯
d
ex2−e−x2=x+x36+⋯
e
ex2−e−x2=x2−x324+⋯
